title: सुखसत्ता निबन्धको सङ्कथन विश्लेषण {Syntax Analysis of Sukhasatta Essay}
nepali: अभिव्यक्तिको सबैभन्दा माथिल्लो एकाइ सङ्कथनलाई यस लेखको अध्ययनीय विषयका रूपमा लिइएको छ । यस लेखको मुख्य उद्देश्य सुखसत्ता निबन्धको सङ्कथन विश्लेषण गर्नु रहेको छ । यो अध्ययन गुणात्मक अनुसन्धानको पुस्तकालयीय अध्ययनमा आधारित छ । यसमा सम्बद्धकका आधारमा मात्र सुखसत्ता निबन्धको सङ्कथन विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यहाँ सार्वनामिक, स्थानिक, कालिक, संयोजन, पुनरावृत्ति र लोपका आधारमा व्याकरणिक सम्बद्धक र पर्यायवाची, विपरीतार्थी, समावेशी र सन्निधानका आधारमा कोशीय सम्बद्धकहरूको सङ्कथन विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यस अनुसार सुखसत्ता निबन्धमा त्रिचालिस ओटा सार्वनामिक सम्बद्धक, अठार ओटा स्थानिक सम्बद्धक, तेर ओटा कालिक सम्बद्धक, पन्ध्र ओटा संयोजक प्रयोग भएको पाइन्छ भने पैँतिस ओटा भाषिक आइटम तिन पटकदेखि छब्बिस पटकसम्म पुनरावृत्ति र आठ ओटा भाषिक अंश विभिन्न सन्दर्भमा लोप भएको पाइन्छ । त्यसैगरी सो निबन्धमा दश जोडी पर्यायवाची, पाँच जोडी विपरीतार्थी, पाँच जोडी समावेशी समावेश्य र आठ जोडी सन्निधान कोशीय सम्बद्धकहरू प्रयोग भएको पाइन्छ । यस किसिमले सुखसत्ता निबन्धमा प्रयोग भएका व्याकरणिक सम्बद्धकहरूले व्यक्त विचारलाई कतै विस्तार गर्न, कतै स्पष्टीकरण दिन, त कतै विकल्प दर्साउन, विपरीत स्थिति देखाउन, तुलना गर्न, कार्य कारण दर्साउन लगायत विभिन्न सम्बन्ध जनाउन मद्दत गरेका छन् । त्यस्तै कोशीय सम्बद्धकले सो निबन्धमा व्यक्त विषयवस्तुलाई सिलसिलाबद्ध गर्न सहयोग गरेका छन् । यसरी ‘सुखसत्ता’ मा प्रयोग भएका विभिन्न किसिमका सम्बद्धकहरूले निबन्धलाई सरल, सरस र सम्प्रेषणीय बनाउन मद्दत गरेका छन् ।
american_english: Discourse, the highest unit of expression, is taken as the subject of study in this article. The main objective of this article is to carry out a discourse analysis of the essay "Sukhasatta." This study is based on library research within qualitative methodology. In this, the discourse analysis of the essay "Sukhasatta" has been conducted solely on the basis of cohesive devices. Here, a discourse analysis of grammatical cohesive devices is carried out on the basis of pronominal, spatial, temporal, conjunction, repetition, and ellipsis, and of lexical cohesive devices on the basis of synonymy, antonymy, inclusion, and collocation. According to this, forty-three pronominal cohesive devices, eighteen spatial cohesive devices, thirteen temporal cohesive devices, and fifteen conjunctions are found to be used in the essay "Sukhasatta," while thirty-five linguistic items are repeated from three to twenty-six times, and eight linguistic elements are found to be elided in various contexts. Likewise, ten pairs of synonymous, five pairs of antonymous, five pairs of inclusive-included, and eight pairs of collocational lexical cohesive devices are found to be used in the essay. In this manner, the grammatical cohesive devices used in the essay "Sukhasatta" have helped indicate diverse relationships, such as elaborating expressed ideas in some places, providing clarification in some places, indicating alternatives, demonstrating opposing situations, drawing comparisons, and indicating cause and effect. Likewise, lexical cohesive devices have helped organize the subject matter expressed in the essay in a sequential manner. Thus, the various types of cohesive devices used in "Sukhasatta" have helped make the essay simple, engaging, and communicative.

informal_english: Discourse, which is the topmost unit of expression, has been taken up as the subject of study in this article. The main objective of this paper is to carry out a discourse analysis of the essay "Sukhasatta". This study is totally based on library work within qualitative research. In this, the discourse analysis of the essay "Sukhasatta" is done only on the basis of cohesive ties. Here, discourse analysis is done for grammatical cohesives based on pronouns, spatial terms, time references, conjunctions, repetition, and ellipsis, and for lexical cohesives based on synonyms, antonyms, inclusion, and collocations. As per this, forty-three pronominal cohesives, eighteen spatial cohesives, thirteen temporal cohesives, and fifteen conjunctions are used in the "Sukhasatta" essay, while thirty-five linguistic items are repeated anywhere between three to twenty-six times, and eight linguistic bits are dropped out in different contexts. In the same way, ten pairs of synonyms, five pairs of antonyms, five pairs of inclusive-included words, and eight pairs of collocations are found used as lexical cohesives in that essay. This way, the grammatical cohesives used in the "Sukhasatta" essay have really helped show various connections—like expanding on ideas here, giving clarifications there, showing options, highlighting contrasts, making comparisons, and pointing out cause and effect. Similarly, the lexical cohesives have helped in arranging the essay's subject matter in a proper sequence. Thus, the different types of cohesives used in "Sukhasatta" have helped to make the essay simple, interesting, and nicely communicative.
translator_notes: Title 'Sukhasatta' transliterated. Nepali linguistic term 'sangkathan vishleshan' translated as discourse analysis (not syntax analysis as wrongly glossed in English title). Cohesion terminology mapped to Halliday & Hasan framework (grammatical and lexical cohesives, inclusion/hyponymy, ellipsis, collocation). Strict 10-sentence order maintained across all variants. Informal flavour: Indian English.
